part: Semtech SRV05-4 RailClamp 4-line TVS diode array, SOT-23-6L

datasheet.jlc_db_url: JLC part page C13612, Datasheet link (smtDataManualFile/...-C13612.pdf)

notes: 2026-10-22 (Alex): Semtech's SRV05-4.TCT (C13612, Extended, about 100k in stock at JLC) back in place of hongjiacheng's SRV05-4A (C20615829), so a 30-board order needs no pre-order. Same pinout and package.

Pinout (p1 Schematic and PIN Configuration; p5 Device Connection Options): data lines on pins 1, 3, 4 and 6; the negative reference (REF1) on pin 2, straight to the ground plane; the positive reference (REF2) on pin 5, option 1 directly to the supply rail.

CPL: JLC's library footprint for C13612 (SOT-23-6_L2.9-W1.6-P0.95-LS2.8-BR) has pins 1-3 down its right side, pin 1 at the bottom: KiCad's SOT-23-6 turned 180 degrees (C20615829's was turned 90). Placed at KiCad's angle without a correction, pin 2 (GND) would land on the +3V3 pad. Check U1 in JLC's placement preview.
REF tied to +3V3 rather than VBUS (a deliberate design choice).
Against the SRV05-4A: 3 pF typ, 5 pF max I/O to GND (against 1.0 pF), which USB full speed tolerates; ESD 8 kV contact, 15 kV air; surge 12 A (8/20 us).

ratings.limit: 5 V max; VBR >= 6 V at 1 mA
